chunks: And by his chain, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying that the siblings from the mother do not bar the mother from the third.
ai.seo_question: Do maternal siblings exclude the mother from her inheritance share?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that maternal siblings (uterine brothers and sisters) do not exclude the mother from her fixed one-third share, distinguishing them from full or paternal siblings who might reduce it to one-sixth. This ruling is derived from the specific phrasing in Surah An-Nisa, where the condition for the mother's share reduction is the presence of 'children' (awlād), which jurists interpret as excluding siblings. It highlights the precision of Shia fiqh in interpreting the term 'awlād' to mean offspring rather than all descendants.
